screens.purpose: A worker composes ONE application to someone else's task: what they offer (their own total when the task asks for offers, or the task's own price by its basis), how many people come, an optional exact time, a short note; then the existing explicit review and one send. Every guard, the task revision, the PKG-006 durable journal, the idempotent clientRequestId, the unknown-outcome readback and the exact-replay recovery stay exactly as today in the route.

states: loading — ComposerUnavailable: chrome + StateView loading 'Učitavamo aktuelne podatke…' with a task-shaped skeleton; Back works (route back()).

error (read failed / timed out at 15 s) — StateView error: 'Podatke za prijavu trenutno nije moguće učitati.' / 'Proveri vezu i pokušaj ponovo.' with green 'Pokušaj ponovo'; a late read of an older generation is ignored (unchanged route).
offline — the same StateView error path (the read cannot tell offline apart; do not invent a code); a send without a network lands in the unknown-outcome path.
unavailable — 'Podaci za prijavu nisu dostupni.' (+ 'Proveri Zadatak i radni profil.') with retry.

empty (fresh draft) — OFFERS: price empty, people '1' (or the TOTAL count), no error colour anywhere; summary 'Cena još nije upisana · dolazi 1 osoba'; 'Pregledaj ponudu' disabled with reason 'Upiši svoju cenu da pregledaš ponudu.'.

disabled-with-reason — profile not ACTIVE: reason 'Radni profil još nije aktivan — bez njega ponuda ne može da se pošalje.' + quiet 'Dopuni radni profil' (→ /profil/radnik); task closed: 'Zadatak više ne prima prijave.'; draft invalid: the field reasons listed above.
reviewing — ProductSheet 'Ovo šalješ' with green 'Pošalji ovu Prijavu' and quiet 'Izmeni ponudu'; a changed draft or task revision retires it.
sending — green button 'Slanje…' loading and busy; fields read-only; Back still guarded by the route.
uncertain — notice with the route's message, read-only saved command, green 'Proveri ishod'.

pending (readback done, replay possible) — green 'Ponovi istu Prijavu', saved-command facts and the kept pending sentence; the notice 'Aktuelne Prijave su proverene. Za potvrdu ishoda ponovi isti sačuvani zahtev.' when the route passes it.
known refusal after readback — notice with the refusal text, green 'Pregledaj uslove i uredi novu ponudu' (reset).
journal write failed — notice 'Zahtev nije sačuvan na uređaju. Oslobodi prostor i pokušaj ponovo.', composer stays editable, 'Pregledaj ponudu' live.
corrupt journal — notice 'Sačuvani zapis Prijave nije čitljiv, pa je uklonjen. Proveri svoje Prijave.' over an editable composer.
deadline passed on tap — notice 'Rok za prijave je istekao. Osveži Zadatak.' with quiet 'Osveži Zadatak'.
success — SuccessMark + 'Prijava je poslata.' + sent facts + green 'Otvori moje prijave' (navigates once; blur/account fences unchanged).
